chunks: Then We cracked the earth open under pressure (of germination)
ai.seo_question: What does the splitting of the earth signify in Surah Abasa?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the concept of *al-Ba'th* (resurrection), where the splitting of the earth symbolizes the emergence of the dead from their graves, mirroring the sprouting of vegetation. It serves as a tangible sign (*ayah*) for humanity to reflect on God's creative power and the certainty of the Hereafter, reinforcing the connection between natural phenomena and spiritual truth.
